analysis.summary: During the fiscal year 2025-26, GNA Axles experienced a 4% decline in net revenue to ` 1,478.42 crores due to export pressures from U.S. tariffs, while domestic demand remained robust, particularly in the tractor and commercial vehicle segments. Profit after tax increased by 9.22% to ` 116.99 crores, aided by stringent cost control, optimized capacity utilization, and enhanced operational efficiencies. The company is actively diversifying its product portfolio into light vehicles, passenger vehicles, and SUVs through initiatives like GNA Mobility Limited. Management remains optimistic about domestic demand and potential export recovery, supported by ongoing technological upgrades, automation, and expanding renewable energy adoption.

guidance.claim: Demand for commercial vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25 onwards.
guidance.quote: demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

guidance.claim: Domestic tractor market sales are anticipated to post a lower single-digit growth during the year.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The company's emphasis on optimizing capacity utilization and maintaining strict cost control continues to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Our emphasis on optimising capacity utilisation and maintaining strict cost control continues to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 13.68% for the year.

orders_capacity.claim: Rooftop solar capacity was enhanced to 6 MW in 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ` 3 per equity share for the financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company is executing a 3 MW rooftop solar project.
management_commitments.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its solar capacity further in FY 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.
